title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1973-04-02
lineage: SBD> MR> DAT> SS> CDA> WAV(EAC)> SHN> DAW(Bertha)> CDA/SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a stellar spring ’73 set, highlighted by a soaring Eyes → China Doll transition and a rare Here Comes Sunshine jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board source that most reviewers find clear and well‑mixed, even if one notes the remastered version sounds a bit less crisp than the original. Musically the show shines – Brown Eyed Women, Jack Straw, Loose Lucy and especially the Weather Report Prelude → Eyes → China Doll sequence are repeatedly praised, along with a unique Space jam out of Here Comes Sunshine. Overall it’s regarded as one of the best spring‑73 performances.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are favorable (average 4.33★), with strong praise for performance and generally good soundboard quality; consistent comments allow a confident rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the mix as clear and well‑balanced, noting it sounds better than an alternate source. One comment mentions the remaster is slightly less clear than the original, but overall sound quality is praised.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly, with the Weather Report Prelude into Eyes and straight into China Doll highlighted as a standout transition; the overall pacing is described as strong and engaging throughout the three‑plus hour show.
